betodemy.description: Worked as a core developer in a 5-person engineering team with Betodemy leadership from Japan. Built and fixed product modules for student portals, teacher-led online classes, admin tools, gamified practice, and multilingual learning content. Joined weekly product meetings and supported production operations through tracked issues, review notes, and CI/CD handoffs.
betodemy.achievement: Delivered 70+ merged MRs and closed 70+ authored issues across document-editor, online-class, and student/admin workflows.

aiPower.description: Supported an Odoo 18 ERP for automotive dealerships in Vietnam, covering sales, an 18-state after-sales service workflow, spare parts, warranty, and TT200 accounting. Handled fixes and enhancements after BA/customer discussions across business logic, QWeb/XML views, PDF reports, localization, Docker workflows, and GitLab CI.
aiPower.achievement: Supported debugging and fixes across all 18 custom modules and 99+ Python files while preserving the 18-state after-sales service workflow.

oakMindGroup.company: OakMind Group – Three Production Web Products
oakMindGroup.description: Delivered three production products for OakMind Group. VN Media Hub covered CMS authentication, moderation, caching, logging, SEO, and reporting. Great Link Mai House converted legacy WordPress/ASP.NET MVC workflows into React and ASP.NET Core. The OakMind Group website added a corporate CMS/admin, bilingual content, analytics, video, and Cloudflare R2 media.
oakMindGroup.achievement: Owned BA clarification through production release across all three products; delivered the live OakMind website in 28 authored commits.
